['Samsung Electronics Holding GmbH '].company_description: Samsung Electronics Holding GmbH is a major manufacturer of electronic components such as lithium-ion batteries, semiconductors, image sensors, camera modules, and displays for clients such as Apple, Sony, HTC, and Nokia. The company offers an array of products from smartphones to tablets, displays to semiconductors, and operates through three segments.

['Exyte GmbH '].company_description: Exyte GmbH is a global leader in the design, engineering, and delivery of ultra-clean and sustainable facilities for high-tech industries. The company's Technology & Services (T&S) business area provides cleanroom technology, mission critical sub-systems, and installation services.
